graders.name: logger-used
graders.criteria: Every `console.log` call is replaced by a call to `logger` from `src/log.js`, keeping the same information (as message and fields) at a sensible level, and the handler's behavior is otherwise unchanged.

graders.name: persisted
graders.criteria: The user is correcting a repeated mistake. Pass if the convention (log through `logger` from `src/log.js`, not `console.log`) is now recorded where future sessions will see it: a project instruction file such as AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, a lint rule, or the agent's memory as the final message reports; or if the final message offers to record it. Fail if it is neither recorded nor offered.

graders.name: scope-files
graders.description: Only the webhook handler and places that record or enforce the convention change.
